intro.text: Where... where am I? A corn maze? But how did I get here?
Wait... the farm. I remember the farm. I was just... somewhere else. But where?
It was like a Halloween carnival. Employees smiling at me... Why can't I remember what happened?
Maybe it's a dream. Maybe I'm just crazy. Or maybe...just temporary amnesia?
Whatever it is, I need to get out of here.
It's just a corn maze, right? Corn mazes are supposed to be fun. Let me just find the exit, and I can figure things out later

Looks like there is a note here. Maybe it will help me figure out what's going on. 
 [PRESS E TO INTERACT WITH OBJECTS]

continue_toast_1.text: How did I get here? I was just... somewhere else. But where?

continue_toast_2.text: The maze again. It's always the maze. How many times have I been here?

continue_toast_3.text: I died, didn't I? But I'm back. Did I just dream it?

continue_toast_4.text: The corn whispers my name. No, not my name. I don't know. Who am I?

continue_toast_5.text: Am I dreaming? Or am I just crazy?

flashlight_after_3m.text: It's getting dark. I should probably find the exit. Glad I brought a flashlight.

entered_effigy_area.text: Rope. Burlap. A shape pretending to be a person. Someone wanted me to see this.

weird_thing_found.text: Another trinket. Another whisper in my handwriting. How many versions of me are here?

effigy_stage2_seen.text: Did the scarecrow... change? No, it's just my imagination.

effigy_stage3_seen.text: No. It's definitely changed. I swear it's watching me, following me.

effigy_stage4_seen.text: What the... Its coming for me!

item_broken_glass.text: Sharp glass. Reflects a face that might be mine.

item_holy_book.text: A holy book. Someone prayed here. It didn't help them.

item_flag.text: An old flag. Symbols of a world outside the maze.

item_phone.text: A dead phone. No signal. No one to call. No one who'd answer.

item_symbol_coin.text: A weird coin. Will picking it up give me good luck, or bad luck?

sanity_90.text: Something feels off about this place...

sanity_80.text: I'm lost. This maze is bigger than I thought.

sanity_70.text: I'm being watched. I know I'm being watched.

sanity_60.text: The scarecrows... they're not where they were before.

sanity_50.text: I need to get out. Now. Something's very wrong here.

sanity_40.text: They're moving. I see them moving when I'm not looking!

sanity_30.text: Can't think straight. The whispers are so loud!

sanity_20.text: No no no no no! They're coming for me!

sanity_10.text: I'm becoming one of them. I can feel it happening!
